classification: Bounded post-R27 repair motivated by a newly disclosed prospective G4 failure and causal ablation; not blind, default, hardware, deployment, or safety evidence.

single_implementation.ownership: Grip must be physically closed. For payload weight above the frozen 0.5 N resolution, G4 support must be valid and at least half carried by the arm. At or below resolution, support fraction is unresolvable and the existing unresolved-load rule applies. For every branch and every optional onset, measured admissible table normal must be finite and <=0.5 N. Unknown is not owned.
single_implementation.onset: The existing horizontal bound and two-sample onset persistence are unchanged. Above-bound onset samples must be contiguous while ownership remains valid; loss of ownership resets the onset counter.
single_implementation.lifecycle: Actual ownership loss immediately terminates a pending optional pulse, clears its active identity, and requires a measured return below the existing release bound before rearming. It never suppresses, delays, shortens, or otherwise changes C1 output.

ordered_validation: unit state tests and source freeze
known 5.25 kg +29 mm tool failure and matched no-offset twin versus both V3 and C1
original prospective R27 36-episode holdback versus both V3 and C1
mass0/mass8 +Y pickup protections requiring same first rises 38/43 ms as V3
authentic official 29+29 landing comparison versus C1 requiring >=17/24, same control cells and false counts
earlier ten tool episodes, signed/pair panel, post-release X/Z, and near-zero panel using frozen runners where applicable

gates.integrity: All passive-detector physics and authentic force traces match; source pins remain frozen.
gates.relative: Record every change separately versus V3 and C1. No new false rise, duplicate, tool prealarm, or stuck tail; no inherited first rise later by >5 ms; no event duration growth >5 samples.
gates.official: At least 17 detected of 24, identical control cells, identical no-impact false count and no worse impact-run false count versus C1.
gates.stop: Any gate failure stops this one-implementation lane without threshold or branch alternatives. True-impact rejection is reported, not broadened.

limits: no public staging, package, remote, default, or frozen-source edits
